PACKAGE BODY pkg_multiselect IS

 tabrec TAB_REC_REC;

 ------------------------------------------
 -- colorize the current selected record --
 ------------------------------------------
 procedure color_select_record 
 (
 blockname in varchar2
 ,numrec in pls_integer 
 ,color in boolean
 )
 is
 LC$item varchar2(60);
 LC$itemdeb varchar2(60);
 LN$len pls_integer ;
 begin
 
 if va_name is null then
 return ;
 end if ; 
 
 -- get the first item of the block --
 LC$itemdeb := Get_Block_Property(blockname, FIRST_ITEM) ;
 LC$item := blockname || '.' || LC$itemdeb ;
 
 -- For every item of the current block --
 while LC$itemdeb is not null Loop
 
 if Get_Item_Property(LC$Item , ITEM_TYPE) NOT IN ('BUTTON','RADIO GROUP','DISPLAY ITEM') Then
 
 if Get_Item_Property(LC$Item , VISIBLE ) = 'TRUE' Then
 if color then
 Set_Item_Instance_Property(LC$item, numrec, VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, va_name);
 else 
 Set_Item_Instance_Property(LC$item, numrec, VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, '');
 end if ; 
 end if ;
 
 end if ;
 
 -- next item --
 LC$itemdeb := Get_Item_Property( LC$item, NEXT_NAVIGATION_ITEM );
 LC$item := blockname || '.' || LC$itemdeb ;
 
 end loop ;
 
 end;

 ------------------------------
 -- find the record in table --
 ------------------------------
 function find_record(vname in varchar2)
 return pls_integer
 is
 r pls_integer := 0;
 begin
 if tabrec.count > 0 then
 for i in tabrec.first .. tabrec.last loop
 if tabrec.exists(i) then
 if upper(tabrec(i).name) = upper(vname) then
 r := i ;
 exit ;
 end if ; 
 end if ;
 end loop; 
 end if ;
 return r;
 end;
 
 --------------------------
 -- clear the collection --
 --------------------------
 procedure clear
 Is
 r pls_integer := 0;
 n varchar2(100) := name_in('system.current_form') || '.' || Name_in('system.cursor_block');
 Begin
 r := find_record(n);
 if r > 0 then
 tabrec(r).tab.delete;
 end if ;
 End;
 
 -----------------------------
 -- clear all form's blocks --
 -----------------------------
 procedure clear_all_blocks
 Is
 r pls_integer := 0;
 n varchar2(100);
 Begin
 if tabrec.count > 0 then
 for i in tabrec.first .. tabrec.last loop
 r := instr( tabrec(i).name, '.' ) ;
 n := upper(substr(tabrec(i).name, 1, r-1));
 if n = upper(name_in('system.current_form')) then
 tabrec.delete(i);
 end if ; 
 end loop; 
 end if ;
 End; 
 
 ------------------------------
 -- get the NUMREC value 0/1 --
 ------------------------------
 function get_state( numrec in pls_integer ) 
 return pls_integer
 is 
 r pls_integer := 0; 
 n varchar2(100) := name_in('system.current_form') || '.' || Name_in('system.cursor_block'); 
 begin
 r := find_record(n);
 if r > 0 then 
 return tabrec(r).tab(numrec);
 end if ; 
 end;
 
 --------------------------
 -- set the NUMREC value --
 --------------------------
 procedure set_state( numrec in pls_integer, value in pls_integer )
 is
 r pls_integer := 0;
 n varchar2(100) := name_in('system.current_form') || '.' || Name_in('system.cursor_block');
 begin
 r := find_record(n);
 if r > 0 then 
 tabrec(r).tab(numrec) := value ;
 else
 r := tabrec.count + 1;
 tabrec(r).name := n ;
 tabrec(r).tab(numrec) := value ;
 end if ;
 end;
 
 -----------------------------
 -- change the NUMREC value --
 -----------------------------
 procedure change_state( numrec in pls_integer )
 is
 r pls_integer := 0; 
 n varchar2(100) := name_in('system.current_form') || '.' || Name_in('system.cursor_block'); 
 begin
 r := find_record(n);
 if r > 0 then 
 if tabrec(r).tab(numrec) = 0 then
 tabrec(r).tab(numrec) := 1 ;
 color_selected_record (numrec, true);
 else
 tabrec(r).tab(numrec) := 0 ;
 color_selected_record (numrec, false);
 end if ; 
 else
 message('not found: '|| n, no_acknowledge);
 end if ;
 end; 
 
 procedure color_selected_record(numrec IN PLS_INTEGER, color IN BOOLEAN) is
 begin
 if color then
 pkg_multiselect.checked_tb(:MASTER_CODES.CODE) := TRUE; 
 Set_Item_Instance_Property('MASTER_CODES.CODE', numrec, VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, 'VA_SELECTED_RECORD');
 Set_Item_Instance_Property('MASTER_CODES.CODE_DESC', numrec, VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, 'VA_SELECTED_RECORD');
 else 
 pkg_multiselect.checked_tb(:MASTER_CODES.CODE) := FALSE;
 Set_Item_Instance_Property('MASTER_CODES.CODE', numrec, VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, '');
 Set_Item_Instance_Property('MASTER_CODES.CODE_DESC', numrec, VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, '');
 end if ; 
 end;
 
 -----------------------------------
 -- get the checked records list --
 -----------------------------------
 function get_checked_list(blockname in varchar2 default null)
 return TAB_CHK
 is
 tb TAB_CHK ; 
 j pls_integer := 0 ;
 r pls_integer := 0; 
 n varchar2(100) ;
 begin
 if blockname is not null then
 n := blockname ;
 else
 n := name_in('system.current_form') || '.' || Name_in('system.cursor_block'); 
 end if ; 
 r := find_record(n);
 if r > 0 then 
 if tabrec(r).tab.count > 0 Then
 for i IN tabrec(r).tab.first .. tabrec(r).tab.last loop
 if tabrec(r).tab(i) = 1 Then
 j := j + 1 ;
 tb(j) := i ;
 end if ; 
 end loop; 
 end if ;
 else
 message('not found: '|| n, no_acknowledge);
 end if ;
 return tb ;
 end;
 
 -----------------------------------
 -- set the visual attribute name --
 -----------------------------------

 is
 va VisualAttribute;

 va := find_va(vaname);
 if Id_Null(va) then 
 va_name := null ;
 else
 va_name := vaname ;

 ,fontweight in varchar2 default null

 )

 if background is not null then

 end if ; 
 end;
 
 
END;

 PROCEDURE init_vars IS
 BEGIN
 UTRS_TESTS.scheduled_tests_before := NULL;
 UTRS_TESTS.cancelled_tests_before := NULL; 
 UTRS_TESTS.scheduled_tests_after := NULL;
 UTRS_TESTS.cancelled_tests_after := NULL; 
 END init_vars;
 
 PROCEDURE store_tests(before_flag IN BOOLEAN) IS
 BEGIN
 IF before_flag THEN
 UTRS_TESTS.scheduled_tests_before := GET_SCHEDULED_TESTS;
 UTRS_TESTS.cancelled_tests_before := GET_CANCELLED_TESTS; 
 ELSE
 UTRS_TESTS.scheduled_tests_after := GET_SCHEDULED_TESTS;
 UTRS_TESTS.cancelled_tests_after := GET_CANCELLED_TESTS;
 END IF; 
 END store_tests; 
 
 PROCEDURE process_new_tests IS
 CURSOR new_tests_cur(lv_tests_before IN VARCHAR2, lv_tests_after IN VARCHAR2) IS
 SELECT test_id
 FROM ( SELECT TRIM(regexp_substr(lv_tests_after, '[^,]+', 1, level)) test_id
 FROM dual
 CONNECT BY regexp_substr(lv_tests_after, '[^,]+', 1, level) IS NOT NULL
 )
 WHERE test_id NOT IN ( SELECT TRIM(regexp_substr(NVL(lv_tests_before, '@#'), '[^,]+', 1, level))
 FROM dual
 CONNECT BY regexp_substr(NVL(lv_tests_before, '@#'), '[^,]+', 1, level) IS NOT NULL
 ) ;
 nCnt NUMBER; 
 BEGIN
 -- check each inserted test.
 FOR rec IN new_tests_cur(UTRS_TESTS.scheduled_tests_before, UTRS_TESTS.scheduled_tests_after)
 LOOP
 -- check if the test is in sample_checkin_conditions
 SELECT COUNT(1) into nCnt
 FROM valid_test_sample_types
 WHERE sample_type = NVL(:ssid.new_sample_type, :ssid.sample_type)
 AND test_id = rec.test_id
 AND :ctrl_blk.chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, :ctrl_blk.chp_sysdate+1); 
 
 IF nCnt > 0 THEN
 INSERT_SCC_TABLE(status_flag_in => 'A', tests_list_in => rec.test_id);
 ELSE
 INSERT_SCC_TABLE(status_flag_in => 'U', tests_list_in => rec.test_id);
 END IF; 
 
 END LOOP; 

 -- check each cancelled test.
 FOR rec IN new_tests_cur(UTRS_TESTS.cancelled_tests_before, UTRS_TESTS.cancelled_tests_after)
 LOOP
 -- cancel the test in sample_checkin_condition
 DELETE FROM sample_checkin_conditions
 WHERE sample_type = NVL(:ssid.new_sample_type, :ssid.sample_type)
 AND test_id = rec.test_id
 AND box_id = :CTRL_BLK.BOX_ID; 
 END LOOP; 
 
 END process_new_tests;
END;
